integrity: Complete analytic Fourier proof and standalone reproducible graph and transform checker; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for graph-square shortest-path distance at exponent one, not the sharp distance-power exponent for other exponents or all bandwidth windows in failing orders. Finite numerical tests are corroborative, and historical novelty screening is necessarily bounded. The even-order full spectrum is previously known (Atik–Panigrahi 2016); the asserted distinct result is the odd-order Fourier formula and full Gaussian-positivity classification.
title: Gaussian positivity on squared cycles: an isolated nine-vertex exception
